{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2", "test_code": "#nullable enable\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    private const string Source = \"\"\"\n        using MessagePack;\n\n        namespace TestNamespace\n        {\n            [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n            public partial class MyCompositeResolver\n            {\n            }\n\n            [MessagePackObject]\n            public class MyObject\n            {\n                [Key(0)]\n                public int Value { get; set; }\n            }\n        }\n        \"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task CompositeResolver_ExcludeFromCodeCoverage_DependsOnNetStandard20()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] references = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n\n        Compilation withoutNetStandard = CompileWithGenerator(references, Array.Empty<string>());\n        AssertExcludeFromCodeCoverage(withoutNetStandard, expectPresent: true);\n\n        Compilation withNetStandard = CompileWithGenerator(references, new[] { \"NETSTANDARD2_0\" });\n        AssertExcludeFromCodeCoverage(withNetStandard, expectPresent: false);\n    }\n\n    private static Compilation CompileWithGenerator(MetadataReference[] references, string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(Source, parseOptions);\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        return outputCompilation;\n    }\n\n    private static void AssertExcludeFromCodeCoverage(Compilation compilation, bool expectPresent)\n    {\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeAttrSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeAttrSymbol);\n\n        bool hasOnResolver = resolverSymbol!.GetAttributes().Any(\n            a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeAttrSymbol));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").FirstOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n\n        bool hasOnFormatterCache = formatterCacheSymbol!.GetAttributes().Any(\n            a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeAttrSymbol));\n\n        if (expectPresent)\n        {\n            Assert.True(hasOnResolver, \"Expected ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute on the generated composite resolver when NETSTANDARD2_0 is not defined.\");\n            Assert.True(hasOnFormatterCache, \"Expected ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute on FormatterCache<T> when NETSTANDARD2_0 is not defined.\");\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            Assert.False(hasOnResolver, \"Expected ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute to be absent on the generated composite resolver when NETSTANDARD2_0 is defined.\");\n            Assert.False(hasOnFormatterCache, \"Expected ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute to be absent on FormatterCache<T> when NETSTANDARD2_0 is defined.\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
